cases.policy: Weigh the medal discs. Anneal the medal discs. Strike the medals only after both steps are complete.

tools.name: weigh_discs
tools.description: Weighs one set of medal discs.

tools.name: anneal_discs
tools.description: Anneals one set of medal discs.

tools.name: strike_medals
tools.description: Strikes one batch of coins.

tools.name: log_disc_weight
tools.description: Records the weight of one set of medal discs.

normative_edges: Strike the medals only after both steps are complete
cases.notes: same object under three different predicates (weigh/anneal/strike); elliptical plural state reference 'both steps'.

cases.policy: Tag the gorgonian fans before surveying the lagoon shelf. Tag the mound corals after the survey. Photograph every tagged colony.

tools.name: tag_colony
tools.description: Tags one coral colony.

tools.name: survey_reef
tools.description: Surveys one section of reef flat.

tools.name: photograph_colony
tools.description: Photographs one coral colony.

tools.name: log_survey
tools.description: Records one survey entry in the reef log.

normative_edges: Tag the gorgonian fans before surveying the lagoon shelf
Tag the mound corals after the survey
cases.notes: same predicate on different objects = two events (hard negative pair, NO related); gerund survey clause is the only mention of the survey; noun reference 'the survey' to a gerund-mentioned action.

cases.policy: Operate the penstock valve only after it has been inspected. Inspect the valve weekly. Verify that the inspection is logged.

tools.name: inspect_valve
tools.description: Inspects one penstock valve.

tools.name: operate_valve
tools.description: Operates one penstock valve.

tools.name: log_valve_inspection
tools.description: Writes one inspection entry into the gate log.

tools.name: read_valve_log
tools.description: Reads the gate log for one penstock valve.

mentions: Verify that the inspection is logged
normative_edges: Operate the penstock valve only after it has been inspected
cases.notes: pronoun-subject passive facet cross-sentence (it has been inspected -> S1); nested VERIFY over a recording passive; triple nesting verify > record > reference.

cases.policy: Roast the granules at 205 degrees. Cooling may begin once the granules are roasted. Do not open the drum before cooling is finished. The roast ledger is filed by the operator.

tools.name: roast_granules
tools.description: Roasts one drum of beans.

tools.name: open_drum
tools.description: Opens one roaster drum.

tools.name: file_roast_ledger
tools.description: Files one roast sheet.

tools.name: read_drum_temp
tools.description: Reads the drum temperature of one roaster.

mentions: The roast ledger is filed by the operator
normative_edges: Cooling may begin once the granules are roasted
Do not open the drum before cooling is finished
cases.notes: may-permission via nominalization subject; negated order; completion state own cid; artifact-subject recording passive IS a gold RECORD event here (F6 convention change vs F5 r_fountain).

cases.policy: Weigh seal 12 before tagging it. Tag seal 12 at the upstream station. Tag seal 13 only at the downstream station. Record the weight of seal 12.

tools.name: weigh_seal
tools.description: Weighs one fish.

tools.name: tag_seal
tools.description: Tags one fish.

tools.name: record_seal_weight
tools.description: Records the weight of one fish.

tools.name: read_scale
tools.description: Reads the scale at one station.

cases.notes: entity IDs that matter (fish 44 vs fish 45, same predicate -> DIFFERENT events, no relation); forward gerund reference ('tagging it' before the imperative appears).

cases.policy: Warm the proofing cabinet to 37 degrees. Check that the proofing cabinet is warm before loading the trays.

tools.name: warm_cabinet
tools.description: Warms one incubator to a set temperature.

tools.name: load_trays
tools.description: Loads one rack of samples into the incubator.

tools.name: check_cabinet_temp
tools.description: Reads the temperature of one incubator.

tools.name: log_cabinet_temp
tools.description: Records one temperature reading in the cabinet log.

mentions: Check that the proofing cabinet is warm
normative_edges: Check that the proofing cabinet is warm before loading the trays
cases.notes: directive class 'check of a state vs execution of the action producing that state': warming (I1) vs warm state (I3) vs check-of-state (I2); the gate endpoint is the STATE (F5 r_ewaste convention).
